post.ref: Baba Sheikh Farid Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1383
post.meaning: You may have forgotten God, but God has not forgotten you.
post.caption:
A Sufi line for a restless heart 🕊️

📖 Baba Sheikh Farid, Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1383

Save कर लें, मुश्किल दिन में काम आएगा। 🔖

#sufi #sufism #sufiquotes #sufipoetry #spirituality

reel.meaning: If you can make yourself as still as a broken gong, you have reached peace; no quarrel is left in you.
reel.caption:
धम्मपद से आज का विचार 🪷

📖 Dhammapada, Verse 134

अगर यह बात सच लगी, तो अपनों के साथ Share करें। 🙏

#buddha #buddhism #buddhaquotes #dhammapada #mindfulness
